score.title: Score {number}
score.intro: Score each bid on each criterion from 0 to 100 on your own. Other evaluators do not see your scores until everyone has sent theirs.
score.notClosed: Bids can be scored once the RFx is closed
score.notEvaluator: You are not an evaluator of this RFx: you see its state, and the result once revealed
score.priceComputed: Computed from the amount before VAT
score.submitBody: Sent scores cannot change. They are revealed once every evaluator has sent theirs.
score.revealedNow: Scores sent, and the totals are revealed
score.recuseBody: Say why, for example an interest in one of the suppliers. Your scores will not count.
score.mineSent: You have sent your scores; waiting for the other evaluators
score.mineRecused: You stepped aside from this evaluation
score.invalid: Type a whole number from 0 to 100

errors.SOD_VIOLATION: You requested a source line or created the RFx, so you may not score it
errors.INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION: This cannot be done in the current state
errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Something is not valid. Please check again
errors.MODULE_DISABLED: Sourcing is not open for this organization
errors.FAILED: That did not work. Please try again

award.title: Award {number}
award.intro: Pick the winner of each line from the bids sent. The amounts before VAT and the VAT per supplier are worked out for you, with what needs a reason; then send it for approval under the DOA.
award.notReady: An award is made once the RFx is closed and its scores are revealed
award.rfi: An RFI is concluded, not awarded
award.readOnly: This award is {status} and cannot be changed
award.reasonHint: Needed when a reason tag shows below, e.g. not the first ranked or split between suppliers
award.submitBody: The suppliers' registry flags, documents and bid validity are checked again, then the award goes to its approver under the DOA. It cannot be changed unless it is returned.
award.saveFirst: Save the award before sending it
award.cancelBody: A cancelled award cannot be used again; its open approval is cancelled and a new award can be made.
award.aboveRequest: {amount} baht above what the requests approved
award.pendingPrice: The winner quoted with VAT: the PO is made once it confirms its prices before VAT

tag.RISK: Risk {tier} not yet assessed: its PO will stop at the risk gate

award.priceFlagsTitle: Unusual prices of the awarded lines
award.routeEscalated: Moved up from rule {rule}: that band's approver took part in this RFx

errors.MODULE_DISABLED: Sourcing is not switched on for this organization
errors.AWARD_REASON_REQUIRED: Give the reason for this award
errors.AWARD_OPEN: This RFx already has an open award
errors.NOT_REVEALED: The scores are not revealed yet
errors.SUPPLIER_FLAGGED: The registry shows the winner as ceased, so it cannot be awarded
errors.DOA_NOT_CONFIGURED: The DOA has no rule for awards yet: ask an administrator to add one
errors.APPROVER_NOT_FOUND: No approver found under the DOA
errors.NO_HIGHER_AUTHORITY: Every band's approver took part in this RFx
errors.CONFLICT_VERSION: The award changed meanwhile: reload the page and try again
errors.INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION: This cannot be done in its current status
errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Something is missing or not valid
errors.EMPTY: Pick the winner of one line at least
errors.UNCHANGED: Nothing changed since the last save
errors.OTHER: That did not work: try again
errors.PO_PENDING_PRICE: A winner has not confirmed all its prices before VAT, so no purchase order yet
errors.AWARD_PRICE_EXCEEDS_BID: The purchase orders at the confirmed prices are above the winner's bid with VAT; ask the winner to confirm lower prices

after.title: After the approval
after.pos: Purchase orders of this award (drafts, sent for approval under the purchase-order authority as usual)
after.agreements: {count} agreed prices made from this award (no purchase order: a need without a request yet)
after.none: This award made no purchase order and no agreed price
after.waiting: Waiting for the winner who bid with VAT to confirm its prices before VAT on the portal; then the purchase orders can be made

list.title: Sourcing
list.intro: The organization's RFQs, RFPs and RFIs: status, close and how many suppliers were invited and sent a bid
list.moduleOff: Sourcing is not switched on for this organization. Ask the BCS team to switch the module on.
list.noMatchHint: Clear the filters to see every RFx
list.emptyHint: RFx you evaluate, approve the award of or hold a request line of show here
list.emptyHintManage: Tick lines without a supplier in the procurement pool and press "Open an RFx from the ticked lines", or open an RFx of a need with this button

errors.MODULE_DISABLED: Sourcing is not switched on for this organization
errors.FORBIDDEN: You may not do this. Only procurement manages RFx.
errors.NOT_FOUND: The RFx or what you picked was not found. Reload the page and try again.
errors.CONFLICT: Someone changed this RFx first. Reload the page to see it now and try again.
errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session ended. Sign in again.
errors.SOD_VIOLATION: This evaluator may not score: they made the RFx or requested one of its lines (BR-SOD ข้อ 14). Pick someone else.
errors.SCORECARD_INCOMPLETE: The scorecard is not complete: criteria must total 100% and it needs its minimum of evaluators
errors.WEIGHTS_SUM: The weights of all criteria must total 100%
errors.PRICE_IS_COMPUTED: Keep one price criterion; the system scores price from the bids
errors.ALREADY_INVITED: This supplier is invited to this RFx already
errors.SUPPLIER_FLAGGED: The registry or the Revenue Department flags this supplier; it cannot be invited
errors.TAX_RATE_NOT_CONFIGURED: No VAT rate covers today. Ask an administrator to set the VAT rate first.
errors.INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION: The RFx is in a state that no longer allows this. Reload the page to see its status.
errors.LINE_IN_RFX: A line is in another RFx that has not ended. Take that line out and try again.
errors.LINE_NOT_IN_POOL: A line left the procurement pool (ordered or cancelled). Pick the lines again in the pool.
errors.LINE_HAS_SUPPLIER: A line has its supplier already: order it from them, or take the supplier off before opening an RFx
errors.PRICE_INCLUDES_VAT: A request priced with VAT cannot go into an RFx yet. Pick lines of other requests.
errors.MIXED_CATEGORY: The ticked lines are of different categories. One RFx takes lines of one category.
errors.NO_DEPARTMENT: Your account has no primary department. Ask an administrator to set it before opening an RFx.
errors.VAT_INCLUSIVE_NOT_ALLOWED: The organization takes bids before VAT only. Turn off "Take prices with VAT".
errors.UNSEAL_REASON: Showing prices before the close needs a reason of 3 characters at least
errors.APPLICATION_NOT_OPEN: This application is closed. Invite an approved one as its supplier.
errors.NO_CONTACT: This supplier has no active contact. Add one on the supplier's page first.
errors.ONE_OWNER: Pick a supplier or an application, not both
errors.DUPLICATE_CODE: Two criteria have the same code. Give every criterion its own code.
errors.MEMBER: An evaluator is not an active member. Pick someone else.
errors.NO_LINES: The RFx has no line yet. It needs one at least.
errors.NO_INVITES: No supplier is invited yet. Invite one at least.
errors.FEWER_INVITES_REASON: Fewer suppliers than the minimum are invited. Give the reason the award's approver will see.
errors.CLOSE_TOO_SOON: The close is earlier than the system allows. Pick a later close.
errors.CLOSE_TOO_SOON_AT: The close is earlier than the system allows. The earliest close is {earliest}.
errors.PAST_CLOSE: The RFx has closed; suppliers can no longer be invited or withdrawn
errors.LAST_LINE: An RFx keeps one line at least
errors.OTHER: That did not work. Try again; if it still fails, tell your administrator.
errors.CONFLICT_VERSION: Someone changed this RFx first. Reload the page to see it now and try again.
errors.ENGLISH_MISSING: A Thai and English document needs its English title and description
errors.LOCALE_REQUIRED: An RFx that invites a foreign supplier or a contact who reads English must be in Thai and English, with the English of the title, the description and every line (item and unit) typed before it opens
errors.CURRENCY: An RFx and its bids are in Thai baht only; nothing is converted
errors.LINE: This line is not one of this RFx

setup.stepsLabel: Steps of setting up the RFx

field.title: RFx title (Thai)
field.allowPartialBids: Take bids that do not offer every line
field.allowVatInclusiveBids: Take prices with VAT (the comparison brings them to before VAT)
field.refUnitPrice: Reference unit price before VAT (baht, optional)
field.sealed: Sealed: suppliers' prices stay hidden until the close
field.sealedHint: The organization's default. While sealed, procurement sees only how many bid until the close.
field.unsealReason: Why prices are shown before the close
field.bilingualHint: Needed to invite a foreign supplier or a contact who reads English. The title, the description and every line need their English before the RFx opens. Nothing is translated for you.

new.title: Open a new RFx
new.introPool: Make a draft RFx of the lines ticked in the procurement pool, then invite suppliers, set the scorecard and the close in the next steps
new.introNeed: Make a draft RFx of a need that has no purchase request yet. Its category and lines come in step 2.
new.poolGone: The ticked lines are no longer in the procurement pool: ordered, or in another RFx
new.noCatalog: The catalogue has no item yet, so there is no category to pick. Procurement adds catalogue items first.
new.poolMissing: {count, plural, one {# line is} other {# lines are}} no longer in the pool and will not go into the RFx
new.poolLines: {count, plural, one {# line} other {# lines}} from the procurement pool
new.generalMissing: Fill in the RFx's title and details first
new.lineMissing: Every line needs its item, quantity and unit

edit.title: Set up an RFx
edit.intro: Go step by step, then open the RFx in Review and open. Opening e-mails every supplier their invitation with a portal link.
edit.introOpen: The RFx is open for bids. Invite more suppliers or withdraw an invitation until the close.
edit.closed: This RFx has closed or ended, so it can no longer be changed or get new invites

lines.label: Lines of the RFx
lines.title: Line {no} · {description}
lines.reference: Reference price {price} baht a unit before VAT ({source})
lines.estimate: Estimated {amount} baht before VAT, so at least {min} suppliers are invited
lines.removeTitle: Take the line out of the RFx
lines.removeBody: {line} leaves the RFx and its request line goes back to the procurement pool
lines.fromPoolHint: This RFx was made from the procurement pool. Lines are added by ticking them in the pool and opening a new RFx.

suppliers.label: Invited suppliers
suppliers.counterOk: {count} invited, the minimum of {min} is met
suppliers.counterShort: {count} invited, the minimum is {min}. Fewer than that needs a reason when opening.
suppliers.warnRisk: Risk not cleared; its purchase orders will stop at the risk gate
suppliers.pickApplication: Or invite a new supplier's application
suppliers.uninviteBody: The supplier can no longer bid in this RFx and the invitation link stops working

scorecard.rowInvalid: Every criterion needs a code (capital letters, 20 at most), a Thai name and a weight from 0 to 100
scorecard.evaluatorsHint: At least {min} evaluators. Each scores the criteria other than price without seeing the others' scores.
scorecard.priceOnly: This scorecard has price only: the system scores it at the close and needs no evaluator
scorecard.sodNote: Whoever made the RFx and the requesters of its lines may not evaluate it (BR-SOD ข้อ 14); they cannot be picked

schedule.rule: {days} business days from the opening. Opened now, it closes at {earliest} at the earliest.
schedule.cutoffRule: Questions close {days} business days before the close; the system works it out

review.invites: {count} invited, the minimum of {min} is met
review.invitesShort: {count} invited, fewer than the minimum of {min}: a reason is needed
review.tooSoon: The close is too early. The earliest is {earliest}.
review.fewerReason: Why fewer suppliers than the minimum are invited
review.fewerReasonHint: The award's approver sees this reason
review.openTitle: Open the RFx and send the invitations
review.openBody: The RFx gets its number, the scorecard is locked and every supplier gets an invitation e-mail with a portal link. It closes {closes}. Once open it cannot go back to draft.
review.bilingualNeeded: A foreign supplier is invited: choose "Thai and English document" under General and type all the English

detail.title: {number} {title}
detail.stateOnly: You see the status, lines and deadlines of this sourcing event because you requested a line in it. Prices and bids are seen by procurement and those involved only.

kindIntro.RFQ: A request for quotation (RFQ): prices from several suppliers, compared
kindIntro.RFP: A request for proposal (RFP): scored on price and quality
kindIntro.RFI: A request for information (RFI) from suppliers: nothing is awarded

errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session has ended. Sign in again and try once more
errors.MODULE_DISABLED: Sourcing (RFx) is not turned on for your organization
errors.FORBIDDEN: You may not do this. Ask your administrator if you think you should
errors.NOT_FOUND: This item no longer exists. Refresh the page and try again
errors.CONFLICT_VERSION: Someone changed this sourcing event meanwhile. Refresh the page to see the latest and do it again
errors.INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION: This cannot be done in the current status. Refresh the page to see the latest status
errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Something is missing or not valid. Check the fields and try again
errors.PAST_CLOSE: The bids have closed, so questions can no longer be answered and nothing can be amended or extended
errors.AWARD_OPEN: An award is still undecided. Cancel it on the award page first, then cancel the sourcing event
errors.NOT_RFI: Only a request for information (RFI) is concluded; an RFQ or RFP ends with an award
errors.CLOSE_NOT_LATER: The new close must be later than the current one
errors.NO_CHANGE: Nothing has changed yet. Change the title, the description or the close
errors.INVITES_WAITING: Some suppliers have not answered yet (neither bid nor declined), so it cannot close early
errors.ASKER_ONLY_REASON: An answer to the asker alone needs a reason of at least 3 characters
errors.SEALED: The bids stay sealed until the close
errors.OTHER: This did not go through. Try again, and contact your administrator if it still fails
errors.LOCALE_REQUIRED: An RFx in Thai and English keeps its English title and description: it invites suppliers who read English

closeEarly.title: Close for bids now
closeEarly.body: Possible once every supplier has answered (bid or declined). After the close no bid can be sent or changed, and the sealed bids open to those who read prices. This cannot be undone.

conclude.title: Conclude the request for information (RFI)
conclude.body: The RFI ends with this conclusion: no award and no purchase order, and lines from the pool go back to wait for purchasing. This cannot be undone.
conclude.confirm: Save the conclusion and end the RFI

cancel.title: Cancel this sourcing event
cancel.body: Invited suppliers are told, no bid is used, and lines from the pool go back to wait for purchasing. This cannot be undone.

overview.cancelledWith: This sourcing event was cancelled. Reason: {reason}

sourceValue.POOL: Lines waiting in the purchasing pool

overview.sealed: Sealed: nobody sees a price until the close
overview.unsealed: Unsealed: procurement sees prices while open (other suppliers do not)

timeline.title: Activity
timeline.empty: No activity yet. Opening, amending and closing show here

event.rfx_opened: Opened for bids and invitations sent
event.rfx_reopened: Opened again from a cancelled one

lines.title: Lines to price
lines.empty: No lines yet. Add them on the draft's edit page

suppliers.title: Invited suppliers
suppliers.needsReconfirm: Must confirm the bid against the revision

questions.title: Questions from suppliers
questions.intro: An answer to all never names who asked, and no question or answer may hold a price
questions.empty: No supplier has asked a question
questions.closedForAnswers: The bids have closed: questions not answered yet stay unanswered

form.publishedHint: Word it again if the original tells who asked; the asker's own words are kept
form.visibilityALL: Every supplier still in the event (without naming the asker)
form.visibilityASKER: The asker only (the question tells a trade secret of the asker)
form.sendAll: Send the answer to every supplier
form.sendAsker: Send the answer to the asker
form.confirmAll: Every supplier still in the event gets this question and answer by e-mail and in the portal. It cannot be changed once sent.
form.confirmAsker: Only the asker gets this answer. It cannot be changed once sent.

extend.heading: Extend the close
extend.hint: Later than the current close; the question cut-off moves with it
extend.invalid: Not a valid date and time
extend.confirmBody: Every invited supplier is told the new close by e-mail. The close only moves later.

amend.heading: Issue a revision
amend.summary: Summary of the change (sent to suppliers)
amend.title: Title
amend.closesAtHint: Change it only to move the close later
amend.closesAtInvalid: Not a valid date and time
amend.send: Issue the revision and tell the suppliers
amend.confirmBody: Every invited supplier gets the summary, and those who have bid must confirm or bid again. This cannot be undone.

bids.title: Bids
bids.sealed: The bids are sealed: only how many came and from whom can be seen
bids.sealedUntil: The bids are sealed until {at}: only how many came and from whom can be seen
bids.compareIntro: Every amount is before VAT (a bid quoted with VAT is brought to its amount before VAT) so they compare directly
bids.foreignWarning: Foreign supplier: VAT 0 in this table · the true cost adds the VAT the buyer remits itself (P.P.36); the withholding tax (P.N.D.54) and the payment are made outside BCS
bids.exportOpenFailed: The file was made but could not be opened. Press again

sheet.title: Bid of {supplier}
sheet.intro: Prices as the supplier quoted them, terms and attachments
sheet.fileWaiting: {name} (waiting for the virus scan, cannot be opened yet)
sheet.fileFailed: The file could not be opened. Try again

scores.title: Scoring
scores.none: This sourcing event has no scoring
scores.noRanking: No bid covers every line, so there is no ranking
scores.notRevealed: The ranking shows once every evaluator has sent their scores
scores.priceComputed: Computed by the system from the prices

awards.title: Award
awards.openManage: Go to pick the winners and send for approval
awards.rfi: A request for information (RFI) awards nothing
awards.pendingPrice: Waiting for winners who quoted with VAT to confirm their prices before VAT; then the purchase orders are made
awards.pos: Purchase orders made from this award
awards.nothingMade: No purchase order or agreed price made from this award yet
